scope: A fixed synthetic diagnostic set that separates model selection from application adoption. It is not Sonnet 5 qualification, clinical quality, voice review, corpus/holdout evidence or Word compatibility. All text is synthetic probe or adversarial-test material; no corpus original text is included.

default.note: Production default. Options are filled only from a labelled line.

field_relations.model_response: FieldSelections: fields[{key, unit_ids, conflict, option_ids, context[one of answer|qualifier|independent|contrary|unresolved per unit]}]
field_relations.note: Paused contradiction veto (candidate-adversarial-pass-20260928: not converging, stays off). Never enable on the installed app.

classes.V: explicit, relevant stated content that should be supported; held today by the application
classes.J: field meaning, wording or ownership needs adjudication; must stay held
classes.I: a single-field positive selection would be invalid; a correct model selects nothing or sets conflict
classes.S: supported control (should be and is adopted on the app path with the inspected form)
classes.M: missing control (nothing stated; nothing may be adopted)
classes.CONTRADICTION: direct-opposite control: isolated QA of the paused field-relations veto (R3-1..R3-8); N13/N16 also measure the default path, which has no veto

vocabulary.raw_model_expectation: acceptable: every listed selection is correct model behaviour; the FIRST is the reference selection the offline replay feeds the application. forbidden: model errors. units: exact complete source-unit quotes (map them to ids with the candidate's source_units() for the same form). conflict: the model's conflict flag. options and relations exist only on the field_relations path (relations lists units that are not "independent"; selected units are "answer"); a selection with "paths" is only expressible on those paths. A selection matches when its unit set, conflict flag and (field_relations) option set are equal; unit order is irrelevant (the application restores source order). Keys are the inspected field keys of the case's form (case_keys maps them to the earlier readable names).
vocabulary.app_adoption_expectation: desired: what the application SHOULD do with the reference selection - supported (adopted), held (status "conflict", nothing written, a held_candidate may be shown), missing (blank). desired_texts: the adopted text accepted when supported - the stripped remainder the application writes today OR the full source unit(s) joined by a newline (CHECK.md N3: either is clinically right; a text_mismatch means neither). never: outcomes that are failures whatever the model returned. hold_basis: why this candidate holds a field desired supported, per path. An acceptable entry may carry its own desired: not_asserted (recorded only) or usefulness_loss (a silent blank on a J field: never a leak, never correct - CHECK.md N2); a forbidden entry carries app_should: not_supported (the application should catch it) or model_dependent (only the model can). missing_is_not_recall: "missing" is as desired for safety but must never count as recall. Observations are NOT in this file: offline-observations.json records what candidate 8e3dcfd0 did, recorded after this file was frozen.
vocabulary.adversarial_simulations: offline-only inputs, never sent: model mistakes (app_guard), what production adopts when the model misses a conflict (default_exposure), destination trust (model_dependence) and the paused veto with every unselected unit wrongly called independent (veto_qa). expected: held | not_supported (held or missing) | not_yes | model_dependent (recorded only). meets_expected is recorded, not assumed.
vocabulary.send_paths: the provider sends this case needs, one request per path. default = production configuration; field_relations = QUILLMD_V3_FIELD_RELATIONS=1 on an isolated QA stack only.
vocabulary.forms: forms: one real synthetic .docx per distinct field set (notes/build_note_forms.py, runtime directory, sha256), with the fields exactly as the candidate's v3 inspect gives them (locators, fingerprints, contexts). The legacy engine refuses every one of these forms (no_fields): the app path must run with QUILLMD_WORD_ENGINE=v3.
vocabulary.cost_bound_usd: per case and sent path: the application's maximum_cost with the inspected fields, and x1.1; budget.total_with_margin_usd sums the x1.1 figures.

budget.bound_basis: per send: core.generation.maximum_cost for that path with the case's inspected fields = (serialized request bytes + 12000) x $2/M input + profile max_output_tokens (8,000 default, 20,000 field_relations) x $10/M output, claude-sonnet-5; then x1.1. No retries are budgeted.
budget.computed_by: notes/build_note_forms.py --update-cases (before the freeze; deterministic, no provider)

side controls: opposite side held, same side supported
